6.description: [Alar] [Area 52] - All changes pending restart.
[The Arcatraz] [Harbinger Skyriss] Akkiris Waker is no longer immune to Nature Spells.
[Karazhan] [Prince Malchezaar] Corrected an issue where Prince Malchezaar occasionally would reset his attack timer, causing him to attack more often then intended especially during movement phases.
[Karazhan] [Chess Event] Corrected an issue where The Hordes Warlocks Poison Cloud would deal no damage.
[Karazhan] [Chess Event] Increased the damage interval of Rain of Fire and Poison Cloud to 1 second up from 5 seconds and reduced damage per tick accordantly.
[Karazhan] [Chess Event] Increased the damage absorbed by Pawn Pieces defensive abilities by 700%.
[Karazhan] [Chess Event] Increased the damage dealt of all Chess Pieces Physical Special Attacks by 100%.
[Karazhan] [Netherspite] Corrected an issue where Netherspite would sometimes skip or delay his events.
[Karazhan] [Shade of Aran] Improved Shade of Arans basic spell casting, he will now cast back to back without delays.
[Karazhan] [Shade of Aran] Reduced the berserker timer of Shade of Aran to 11 minutes down from 12 minutes.
[Karazhan] [Shade of Aran] Corrected an issue where Shade of Aran would sometimes skip or delay his events.
[Karazhan] [Terestian Illhoof] Corrected an issue where Kilrek would sometimes skip or delay his events.
[Karazhan] [Terestian Illhoof] Corrected an issue where Terestian Illhoof would sometimes skip or delay his events.
[Karazhan] [The Curator] Increased the frequency of Hateful Bolt to 6 seconds up from 8 seconds and 3 Seconds up from 4 Seconds during The Curators final phase.
[Karazhan] [Nightbane] Corrected an issue where Nightbane would sometimes skip or delay his events.
[Karazhan] [Nightbane] Nightbane no longer casts Tail Sweep.
[Karazhan] [The Opera - Romulo and Julianne] Romulo and Julianne now have a 3 seconds delay on her auto attacks after being resurrected.
[Karazhan] [The Opera - Romulo and Julianne] Corrected multiple issues where Julianne would sometimes skip or cancel her events.
[Karazhan] [The Opera - The Wizard of Oz] Corrected an issue where Dorothee would sometimes auto attack between her casts.
[Karazhan] [The Opera - Red Ridding Hood] Corrected an issue where The Big Bad Wolf would sometimes skip his Terrifying Howl ability.
[Karazhan] [The Opera] - The Spotlight will no longer restrict spells that do not have a Mana, Energy or Rage cost.

[Karazhan] [The Opera] Spectral Patrons inside the Opera can now be killed and looted before the Opera Event has been started for the first time. After the first start of the encounter Patrons are respawned untargetable acting as the audience during the encounter.
[Karazhan] [Maiden of Virtue] The Maiden of Virtue now has a short delay on her auto attack after finishing her Desperate Prayer cast.
[Karazhan] [Maiden of Virtue] Corrected an issue where the Maiden of Virtue would sometimes skip or delay her events.

[Karazhan] [Moroes] Lord Crispin Ference No longer immediately interrupts his primary target when his primary target casts a spell. Lord Crispin Ference will now periodically check if his target is casting and will interrupt the target if its casting, else will recheck on a longer cooldown.
[Karazhan] [Moroes] Lady Keira Berrybuck and Lord Crispin Ference no longer repeat their Divine Shield and Shield Wall abilities after being casted once.
[Karazhan] [Attumen the Huntsmen] Corrected an issue where Attumens Felfire would sometimes immediately despawn after being summoned.
